//why: These three modules are published for other repositories to import, and jx-platform — the first real subscriber — sets exactOptionalPropertyTypes, verbatimModuleSyntax and isolatedModules, none of which the jx root tsconfig sets. Two type errors were found by consuming the API rather than by building it: `from: string | undefined` did not satisfy `from?: string` under exactOptionalPropertyTypes. Compiling this directory under the stricter set means the next one is found here instead of after a release. `types: []` and a bare lib are the other half: layout.ts and document.ts must not depend on node or DOM globals, because a Worker build, a Vite plugin or a Deno host has to be able to read them.
